results.description:
Finding love was never part of Damon's plan . . .

As the oldest of nine siblings, Damon Townsend traded college for a mechanic's shop in order to help raise his younger brothers and sisters. Years later, those sacrifices have paid off. He's built a motorcycle empire, designs custom bikes for celebrities and billionaires, and owns the country's most successful motorcycle dealership. With all of his siblings now happily settled, they're convinced it's finally Damon's turn to find love. Too bad he doesn't have time for it. He's focused on a project that could change everything. Then the one woman he can't stop thinking about crashes back into his life while running for hers.

President Sutton Ramsey is used to fighting for what she wants. From Olympic fencer to the youngest woman ever elected President of the United States, she's never backed down from a challenge. Especially not Damon Townsend. The infuriating biker has never been impressed by her job, and every encounter between them ends in a battle of words. However, their chemistry is undeniable. But a small-town motorcycle mechanic and the President of the United States could never have a future.

Then someone tries to kill Sutton. Forced to make a run for her life, Sutton's only chance at survival is the last man anyone would expect to protect her. Damon doesn't hesitate. One look at the ambush, one twist of the throttle, and she's on the back of his motorcycle with bullets and killers in pursuit. The even bigger problem is that the attack could only have been orchestrated by someone she trusts.

Unable to return to Washington, Sutton disappears into the quirky small town of Shadows Landing where Damon is determined to keep her safe while they hunt for the traitor in her inner circle. Every heated argument ignites undeniable chemistry, every stolen glance chips away at their defenses, and one unforgettable kiss changes everything. But as the killer closes in and the conspiracy unravels, Damon and Sutton must decide if risking their hearts is worth the price. Because this time, falling in love could be the one mistake that gets them both killed.
